remarks: Meticulously maintained and thoughtfully updated, this spacious end-unit 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath condo offers a flexible layout designed for a variety of lifestyles. The main level features a bright open-concept living and dining area filled with natural light, complemented by a functional kitchen with ample cabinetry and counter space-perfect for everyday cooking or entertaining. Upstairs, both bedrooms offer generous closet space and their own full bathrooms, providing privacy and convenience. A standout feature of this home is the fully finished basement with heating and cooling. This expansive level includes a dedicated laundry area and exceptional versatility-ideal as a home office, media room, playroom, fitness area, or can be converted into an additional bedroom. There is also potential to add a bathroom with the proper city permits. Parking is simple with tandem spaces for two cars, plus additional street parking. Perfectly located in Stamford's vibrant Mid City, this home is just a short walk (0.3 miles) to a lively shopping center featuring Whole Foods, CVS, Starbucks, Shake Shack, and the iconic Frank Pepe's Pizza. The community is pet-friendly, and Stamford Train Station is only 1.5 miles away, making commuting fast and convenient. You'll also enjoy easy access to Bull's Head Shopping Center, Mill River Park, a variety of cafes, restaurants, fitness studios, and cultural attractions like the Stamford Museum & Nature Center. Major roadways are nearby.
